partitions.development: Existing visible cases used for harness debugging; never reported as locked confirmation.
partitions.validation: New cases used to choose feasible ranges and reporting formats before sealing.
partitions.locked: Pre-generated and hashed confirmatory cases; does not exist until Phase 3.

leakage_controls: Q is promoted before any held-out or negative query exists.
Every isolated query starts from the same post-Q checkpoint.
Family labels and expected outcomes remain evaluator-side only.
Analysis logic is frozen before locked outcomes are opened.
notes: Draft control document. Phase 1 and Phase 2 may refine this protocol. Any locked campaign requires a new committed sealed revision.
